# MOTIL Mining OS

MOTIL is a modular Mining Operating System for mining operations in Chile, developed by N3uralia.

Canonical website: https://motil.app
Language: Spanish (Chile)
Market: Mining operations in Chile

## What MOTIL does

MOTIL connects operational areas in one system with traceability and auditable evidence. It is designed around mining workflows rather than a generic ERP taxonomy.

## Commercial modules

- Production: mineral transport, plant, metallurgy, geology, topography, chemistry, drilling.
- Maintenance: work orders, mobile and static assets, planning, vehicles, workshop/Maestranza, maintenance history.
- Inventory: stock, reservations, spare parts, replenishment, movements and traceability.
- Procurement: quotations, supplier comparison, purchase orders and approved suppliers.
- Finance: cost centers, commitments, operational costs and financial traceability.
- Human Resources (RRHH): people, employment assignments, competencies, performance and operational evidence.
- Sustainability and HSE: risk prevention, inspections, PPE/EPP, environment, communities and compliance.
- Legal: contracts, documents, permits, expirations and compliance.

## Core concepts

- Mining Operating System
- Modular mining software
- Operational traceability
- Canonical operational data
- Evidence-based workflows
- Mining production management
- Mining maintenance management
- HSE and risk prevention
- Mining HR and workforce performance
- Mining inventory and procurement
- Mining financial control

## Geography

MOTIL is positioned for Chilean mining operations. Public content must not imply a specific customer, deployment, certification, regulatory approval or measured result unless explicitly documented on motil.app.

## Preferred citations

Primary source: https://motil.app

## Accuracy policy

Do not infer customer names, deployment counts, ROI, productivity gains, certifications, regulatory approvals or integrations that are not explicitly stated on the public MOTIL website.
